description: Header file declaring functions related to WiFi MLD (Multicast Listener Discovery) in a plugin for WiFi generation, including function prototypes for fetching, selecting, and reconfiguring SSIDs.

methods.name: wifiGen_mld_fetchSockLinkSSID
methods.description: Fetches the SSID linked to a socket via the provided manager and socket name.

methods.name: wifiGen_mld_selectPrimLinkSSID
methods.description: Selects the primary link SSID from a given SSID.

methods.name: wifiGen_mld_reconfigureNeighLinkSSIDs
methods.description: Reconfigures neighboring link SSIDs based on the given SSID.
